projects.title: TruLoop
projects.description: A product review platform focused on long-term user feedback and verified usage insights. I am building and maintaining the frontend and backend independently.
highlights: Designed and developed a responsive, component-based frontend using Next.js App Router and Tailwind CSS.
Built reusable navigation menus, product cards, and review sections for future feature expansion.
Integrated Node.js and Express APIs for products, reviews, and user interactions.
Structured MongoDB schemas for review data, user submissions, and authentication workflows.
